scope: Independent source review and six application audition tests; no target execution or device-output comparison.
review_status: No actionable failure found in the reviewed finite selected-event path or normal completion-generation flow.
admission: Fresh preserved-CPR/report replay, retained event/track identity, source processing gates and attached-media SHA are checked through shared renderer preparation on each configuration.

The selected zero-origin stereo source stays at its saved 44100 Hz and 1058400 frames. Ordinary 48000 Hz project resampling, gain, pan, mute, solo and automation are bypassed by the explicit source-audition policy.
Preparation retains the original unresolved event and historical report; full-project playback, offline export and DAWproject barriers remain in place.

test_oracle.input: Synthetic signed24 stereo patterns attached to the preserved LoFi template; the media is not asserted to be the original Cubase sound.
test_oracle.method: Sign-extend each source triplet. Construct exact Float32 p/2^23 bits with integer magnitude bit length, biased exponent and mantissa; no converter, AVAudioFile or floating division supplies the expected bits.
checks: Every sample/channel in nine actual schedule-buffer suffixes starting at 0,1,8191,8192,9999,10000,10001,1058398,1058399; copied suffixes cannot alias the original buffer.
Native selection is present; times24, nextUp(24), and greatest finite Double produce startFrame1058400 and no spans, despite inclusive native end selection.
Generic half-frame ties, delay frames, last frame, end clamping and rejection of NaN, infinities and negative seeks.
Same-size media/source/report changes with restored modification time reject fresh admission; previously admitted immutable PCM is preserved and restored input succeeds.
Removed/changed selected event, moved track identity and altered placement reject; all package file bytes are preserved.
Offline AVAudioEngine unity routing of the final257 source frames at source rate compares every output bit without opening an audio device.

completion_review: stop increments playbackGeneration before stopping players, clears pending count, cancels the timeline task and resets meter state. Queued callbacks from a stopped/configured previous generation cannot finish a new run.
The pending count is set for every scheduled player before scheduling starts; callbacks return through DispatchQueue.main before mutating actor state or stopping the engine.
Completion requires both timelineElapsed and pendingPlayers==0 from dataPlayedBack callbacks. This preserves silent tails and no longer treats elapsed wall time alone as audio completion.
The UI timer consults engine.isPlaying instead of stopping at playhead>=duration; audition duration is engine duration, not the zero ordinary-clip project duration.
Invalid new play arguments stop the previous run first; failed configuration clears prior prepared state.

execution_status.observed_result: 171 tests in 25 suites passed; all six audition tests passed, including the added native-selection exact-end assertions and offline AVAudioEngine output comparison.
execution_status.executed_by: Root coordinated full suite; reviewer independently checked retained log and current test source.

limitations: The tests prove admitted buffer arithmetic and application scheduling/copy policy, not a Cubase live scheduler or whole-project signal path.

The offline AVAudioEngine test does not exercise real-time completion races, hardware resampling, device latency or DAC output. Generation gating was inspected in source; final GUI playback/pause/seek/completion checks remain root-owned.
No claim is made that unsupported MIDI, plugins, routing, automation or other native events were reconstructed.

changes_since_initial_review.check: Reversing exactly the two reported attachment-error wording changes reproduces the previous reviewed byte hash. No other source changes.

finalization.gui_validation: Root-owned final GUI checks are outside this independent source/test review.
